## Checklist

- [ ] The diff contains **no game data** (binaries, assets, disc images, decrypted/derivative data).
- [ ] The pre-commit guard is enabled (`git config core.hooksPath .githooks`).
- [ ] `python tests/run_all.py` passes locally.
- [ ] RE claims are tagged **[verified]** / **[inferred]** with addresses (VA for ImageBase `0x400000`).
- [ ] Prior art is credited where this builds on someone else's research.
- [ ] AI-assisted work is disclosed here and via a `Co-Authored-By:` trailer (see [AI-TRANSPARENCY.md](../AI-TRANSPARENCY.md)).
